name: Green Park Provincial Park Campground
note: Campground in Green Park Provincial Park, Port Hill (364 Green Park Rd), beside the shipbuilding museum; run by a leaseholder (KW Green Park Campground) for the province. 20 2-way sites $42, 22 3-way $46, 50-amp 2-way $50 CAD a night; 80 tent sites, cabins. Showers, laundromat, dump station, river beach. Season June 8-Sept 6. Online booking (Campspot). RV Life 4*/$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: greenparkcampground.ca live with a 2026 rate list (2-way $42, 3-way $46, 50A $50 CAD, read 2026-10-07) and Campspot booking; Tourism PEI lists Green Park Provincial Park; CBC 2019 reports the province leasing the campground to an operator; Google 4.0 over 81 reviews with phone; provincial park under concession -> provincial (Atlantic convention), so no private price gate

name: Confederation Trailside Tourist Grounds
note: Small family campground at Tracadie Cross (12398 St. Peters Rd, Route 2), 15 km from Charlottetown, with the Confederation Trail running through it: 25 sites with 2- and 3-way hookups plus 30 unserviced. 2-way $50, 3-way $55 CAD a night. Washrooms, showers, laundry, saltwater pool, rec room. Reservations by phone. RV Life 4*/$$. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: confederationtrailside.com live with a rates page (2-way $50, 3-way $55 CAD daily, read 2026-10-07); Tourism PEI listing (season Apr 1-Oct 31, 25 serviced sites); Google 4.4 over 38 reviews with phone; RV Life 4* $$ (C$38 avg)

name: Somers By The Beach Campground
note: Family campground near Murray Harbour (1937 Gladstone Rd) with 2- and 3-way 15/30-amp sites, open and treed. Sites $54-62 CAD a night for 2 adults, plus HST. Pool, camp store, WiFi, paddleboard and kayak rentals, cabins. Online booking (Campspot, 1-night deposit). --Claude
inclusion_evidence: somerscampground.com live with site rates ($54/$62 CAD per day, read 2026-10-07) and Campspot online booking for 2026-2027; Google 4.8 over 68 reviews with phone; RV Life lists it unrated (quality from Google); C$54 ~ US$39 under the $50 published-rate gate

name: Red Rock Retreat Campground & Cottages
note: Quiet campground at Mayfield (230 Toronto Rd Ext), a few minutes from Cavendish: 18 pull-through and 14 back-in sites with 30-amp, water and sewer, rigs to 35 ft. $54 CAD a night for up to 4 people, weekly $300. Cottages too. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: redrockcottages.com live with a rates page ($54 CAD/night full-service site up to 4 people, read 2026-10-07); Google 4.8 over 55 reviews with phone; Good Sam directory lists it (unrated); C$54 ~ US$39 under the $50 published-rate gate

name: Cumberland Cove Seaside Campground
note: Small (25-site) campground on the bank of the Northumberland Strait (227 Cumberland Cove Rd, Borden-Carleton), 10 minutes from the Confederation Bridge. Serviced sites $46, unserviced $40.25 CAD a night, taxes included. Open late June to Labour Day. Online booking (RMS). --Claude
